Project-owned prose, index, link, or post-completion historical record that does not alter a release baseline, target, artifact, readiness decision, procedure, approval, rollback, product behavior, or remote state
Vue component presentation, CSS, layout, accessibility, browser interaction, or user-visible UI behavior

Client, server, Functions, shared module, or executable script behavior without a data-contract or release-boundary change; governance-only checkers and fixtures that do not change product logic belong to governance-permissions-agents instead
Firestore, Realtime Database, Storage, schema, package contract, migration, Rules, or persisted-data compatibility
Common or project governance, verification policy, permissions, approval policy, coordinator duties, agents, managed sync, or generated AGENTS

Actual build, static generation, package installation or publication, Dev or Prod deploy, or remote acceptance execution; release readiness decision; or release contract, baseline, target, artifact, or procedure change

invalidatedBy: Managed common, governance lock, renderer, validator, project rules, verification policy, generated AGENTS, or verification summary change
Project Markdown, TOML, document routing, verification policy, or project document validator change
Project document validator, its negative fixtures, validator-required documentation route, or verification-policy contract change
Capacity aliases, capacity runbook, capacity measurement command or script, or capacity regression fixture change
Application, Functions, Rules contract, schema, shared module, or domain test change
Product code, Functions, Rules, schema, dependencies, Emulator configuration, test harness, or affected behavior changes invalidate the mapped test results, not unrelated results

After a recorded full-suite success for the current final Dev product candidate, rerun only failed, missing or invalidated tests and combine them with explicitly verified unaffected results; record baseline, final diff, test names, exact commands and independent exits

Unknown impact, suite-wide infrastructure changes, or an explicit checkpoint exception require a full-suite run even before release; a previous release success plus targeted runs cannot replace the current candidate's initial full-suite run

No affected code, configuration, dependency, environment or test change means evidence remains valid, including immediately before Dev deployment; a commit or documentation-only change alone does not invalidate product results
gates.evidenceDestination: Final Dev product-candidate release evidence: one full-suite run after the combined product diff is fixed, then validated reuse or mapped partial refresh per docs/runbooks/local-emulator-testing.md; completion use is limited to unknown-impact or explicit full-suite exceptions. Governance/document-only work does not activate product release gates. Targeted tests remain available in each small checkpoint; record partial runs separately, never as a fresh full-suite pass.

gates.evidenceDestination: Checkpoint callback, acceptance receipt, or release evidence
